description.value: Shaughnessy Restaurant is a garden-inspired sit-down restaurant located within VanDusen Botanical Garden, offering a seasonally driven menu by Chef Pavlo Onopriienko that draws on local seafood, botanicals, and garden produce. Touring cyclists cutting through Vancouver's south side will find a full-service lunch destination amid lush botanical surroundings, with a menu ranging from casual burgers and sandwiches to elegant halibut and scallop dishes. The restaurant is also a venue for weddings and seasonal garden events tied to VanDusen's programming.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully active with a current seasonal menu and a May 2026 event (Fleurs de Villes), confirming the restaurant is open. Menu items tagged '(V)' and '(GF)' confirm vegetarian and gluten-free options, and an 'Order Online' navigation link confirms takeout is available. No bike parking, water refill, Wi-Fi, or washroom details appear anywhere in the website content or OSM tags.
concerns: Restaurant is located inside VanDusen Botanical Garden — visitors may need to pay garden admission to access the restaurant; this is not confirmed from the website content and warrants a note for cyclists.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, publicly accessible restaurant inside VanDusen Botanical Garden with a current menu and upcoming 2026 events; a legitimate stop for touring cyclists seeking a sit-down meal in Vancouver's south side.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu items explicitly tagged '(V)' for vegetarian (e.g., Crispy Eggplant, Grilled Veggie Focaccia) and '(V | GF)' for vegan/gluten-free (e.g., Truffle & Parmesan Fries); vegan cheese also noted on Beet Carpaccio
